step1.title: Making the World's Fastest Website and Other Mistakes w/ Taylor Hunt
step1.description:
Taylor Hunt was tasked with the job to figure out if there was a viable way to improve his company's (Kroger) website performance. What started as a small exploration ended up being a 2-year journey through the full landscape of modern web development.

Today we have him on the stream to talk about what web performance looks like in practice. How sometimes technology can make a difference while at the same time not ultimately being the decider. And all the lessons he learned along the way.
